facts.fact: The PIDA prospectus page records that Kenya and South Sudan signed an agreement at the 30th EACO Assembly for a 2,420 km fibre link extending Kenya's backbone into South Sudan, with construction due to begin in early 2026.

systems.owner: Governments of Kenya and South Sudan

facts.fact: The PIDA prospectus page records that South Sudan and Kenya signed an agreement at the 30th EACO Assembly for a 2,420 km fibre link into South Sudan, with the Ministry of ICT announcing on 8 August 2025 that construction would begin in early 2026.

systems.owner: Governments of Kenya and South Sudan
